defs.def: to remove or get rid of sth/sb 排除；清除；消除

ex.s: I reckon that nanorobots that can eliminate cancerous cells are just around the corner.
ex.t: 我认为能清除癌细胞的纳米机器人指日可待。

ex.s: Government policies that aim to eliminate poverty are also having a beneficial effect.
ex.t: 旨在消除贫困的政府政策也正在产生有益的效果。

defs.def: to defeat a person or a team so that they no longer take part in a competition, etc. （比赛中）淘汰
to kill sb, especially an enemy or opponent 消灭，杀死（尤指敌人或对手）
